title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What is Anori Tech doing?

The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work.

As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development.

We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry.

We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years.

Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market.

Our Motivation

At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg.

About the Role

A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers.

Start date: from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

  • Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications

  • Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case

  • Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor

  • Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware

  • Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost

  • Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud

What You Bring

Must have

  • Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction

  • Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models

  • Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed)

  • Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis

  • Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects

  • Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers

  • Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data

Nice to have

  • Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience

  • Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection

  • Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper)

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway. No one matches a job description 100%. If this role excites you and you are motivated to grow yourself into it, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Work on a product with purpose that redefines the state of art: our product is a key part to enable competitive battery energy storage.

  • Work directly with the founding team on decisions that shape the company. The team is small, so your ideas will matter. A lot.

  • Challenging engineering in an industrial, but research-near environment. We bring research into the industry.

  • A modern stack and methods: Rust, MBSE, everything as code, and the best tools and techniques for the job, chosen on merit.

  • To be both supported and challenged: room to grow, and the expectation that you will.

You might be a fit if

  • You hold yourself to a high standard and don’t settle for "good enough."

  • You want to have a big say in what the Anori BMS looks like and how it works

  • You are eager to try out new tools and enjoy incorporating AI into your work to make your life easier and more productive

  • You are excited about startups and all the opportunities and uncertainties that come with it

  • You want to be an active part in accelerating the energy transition in Europe

  • You are comfortable with English as a working language

  • You are happy to be in the office most of the time because for fast decisions we need to be in the same room. We expect you to be in the office at least 3 days / week

Interview Process

  1. First Call A short chat with one of our founders. We'll get to know your background and answer any questions you have about Anori Tech. 30 min

  2. Deep Dive with Case Study (on-site) A meeting with Stefan, our CTO. We want to understand how you work and talk through your past projects. The meeting also includes a small case study, and we will send you some context information for it beforehand. 2 - 3 hours

  3. Meet the Team (on-site) Time to meet your future colleagues! In this meeting we get to know each other. This is also the time to discuss final details like salary. 1 - 2 hours

The on-site meetings will be at our lab at the Bahrenfeld Startup Lab: Luruper Hauptstraße 1, 22547 Altona

You also want to become an Anori? We cannot wait to meet you. Go and click the apply button. Don’t be shy, we are nice.

P.S. Extra bonus if you tell us what your favorite type of tea is.

The BMS is where software meets power. ChillQuanta is developing an electro-optic spectrometer for inspecting and characterizing photonic qubits (semiconductor quantum-dot single- and entangled-photon sources), aiming to replace or combine today's separate methods (capacitance-voltage, photoluminescence, resonance fluorescence spectroscopy) with one new sub-100-femtosecond-resolution, non-destructive electro-optic technique — with a patent filing already in progress. Founded by Amar Alok (CEO, PhD in Experimental Physics from RUB, 4+ years in ultrafast optics and pump-probe spectroscopy) alongside a Chemistry postdoc, ChillQuanta has a lab prototype (TRL 3-4) benchmarked against single-atom data, an Invention Disclosure accepted by RUB (April 2026) with a manuscript in preparation for Physical Review Letters, and over €12k raised so far. The next step is turning the lab prototype into an automated instrument and deciding between licensing and starting a company — which is where a business co-founder comes in. ChillQuanta is separately also open to an AI/ML co-founder to help build wafer-scale AI prediction capability.

Tasks

What you will own

Company build-up & strategy
- Help decide and execute the path from lab prototype to company: licensing vs. start-up, incorporation, and go-to-market strategy for the quantum/semiconductor metrology market.
- Own fundraising strategy and investor relations as ChillQuanta moves beyond its initial ~€12k raised.

Commercialization
- Turn the lab prototype (TRL 3-4) into an automated, sellable instrument in partnership with the technical team.
- Build relationships with semiconductor and quantum chip makers as early customers and design partners.
Business operations
- Establish the commercial and operational foundation (pricing, business model, partnerships) the founding science team doesn't yet have.

Requirements

title: SAP Koordinator (m/w/d) – Schnittstellen, Berechtigungen & Dienstleistersteuerung
description:
Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen.

Warum diese Rolle?

Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält.

• Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft.

• Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten.

• Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung.

• Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein.

• Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben.

• Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen.

• Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen.

• Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt.

Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Sie steuern ihn und sind die Ansprechperson für alles im SAP-Umfeld, wofür es noch keine klare Zuständigkeit gibt.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Eine IT-nahe oder kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium

• Mehrere Jahre SAP-Erfahrung im Inhouse-Betrieb eines Unternehmens, idealerweise mit ECC 6.0

• Technischen Tiefgang: Sie lesen Dumps und Traces, kennen Jobs, Transporte und Tabellen und sprechen mit dem Basis-Dienstleister auf Augenhöhe

• Praxis mit IDocs, RFC und EDI sowie mit Rollen und Berechtigungen (PFCG, SU53)

• Erfahrung in Projekten und in der Steuerung externer Partner, dazu Ausdauer beim Nachhaken

• Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

• Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Middleware und erste Berührungspunkte mit S/4HANA

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung

Interesse?

Wenn Sie sich in dieser Rolle wiederfinden, senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin.

What you’ll be doing:

Reporting to the Risk Operations Lead, you will be responsible for daily monitoring within multiple risk queues along with various operational tasks including but not limited to:

  • Use reports, risk signals, case trends, operational data, and web-service tools to identify emerging threats, high-risk or suspicious activity, and opportunities for proactive mitigation.

  • Balance portfolio protection and chargeback risk by assessing chargeback likelihood alongside the merchant’s capacity to repay.

  • Identify recurring issues, control gaps, and risk patterns across tools, workflows, queues, policies, and playbooks, and recommend practical improvements.

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Data Lead to build Plasma's data function from the ground up. You'll be our first dedicated data hire, working across Consumer, Payments and Business to give the company one trusted view of its users, its money and its operations.

At first you'll build much of the platform yourself: our Snowflake warehouse, the pipelines that feed it and the modelled layer on top. As the function grows, you'll choose the tools, set the standards and hire the team.

The Work

  • Own Plasma's data platform end to end: the Snowflake warehouse, ingestion from production systems and third-party providers, and the modelled layer the rest of the company builds on

  • Define the metrics the company runs on, including funded users, activation, engagement, balances, spend and retention, and make sure every team uses the same definitions

  • Partner with Consumer to understand how users behave across regions, segments and products, and turn that into specific product decisions

  • Design and analyse experiments, and be clear about when a result is real and when it isn't

  • Work with Payments and finance so the business can trust its numbers: reconciliation across ledgers, providers and banking partners, revenue reporting and unit economics

  • Find fraudulent and abusive patterns across onboarding, funding, card spend and transfers, and build the signals and rules that let risk and operations act on them

  • Treat data quality, testing, access control and PII handling as part of the platform, not an afterthought

  • Choose tools deliberately, set standards for the function and hire the team as Plasma scales

The Bar

  • A senior, hands-on data practitioner with a track record of both building a data platform and using it

  • Deep SQL and data modelling skills, with enough engineering range to build and run production pipelines yourself

  • Comfortable starting from very little, and building something that still makes sense when the team is five times bigger

  • Strong judgment on tradeoffs: speed vs. rigour, build vs. buy, a quick answer now vs. a reusable model later

  • You turn analysis into decisions. You can explain a finding to a non-technical leader in a few sentences and tell them what to do about it

  • You communicate clearly, write clean, tested code, and lead through technical decisions whether or not you're managing people yet

  • You have very high agency. You don't wait to be told which problem to work on; you go and find the ones that matter

Nice to have

  • You've been an early or founding data hire at a fast-growing fintech

  • Experience with real money data at a fintech: payments, cards, ledgers, settlement, chargebacks or FX. You know the ways financial data goes wrong

  • Hands-on fraud, risk or financial-crime analytics

  • Familiarity with stablecoins and on-chain data, including how blockchain transactions map to accounts, balances and ledgers

  • Experience hiring and growing a data team

  • Machine learning in production for fraud, risk or personalisation

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

Compensation: $180K – $300K • + Tokens

title: Manager: Compliance Advisory (and Data Protection)
description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

You'll join our Service guild and work across first line operations, sales and produt. Working closely with Protect (our second line) you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance solutions look like. Then implement them , keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.

The opportunity

We want compliance and data protection built into how we design, sell and run our products, not bolted at the end.

As our hands on compliance adviser in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.

Compliance advisory is the heart of this role and will take around 70% of your time. You’ll also pick up a smaller, complementary slice of work as our Data Protection Officer (DPO), around 30% of your time. DPO experience is a plus but not essential, and we’ll train you if you need it.

What success looks like

In your first year, compliance advisory is where you’ve made your mark. You’ve sought out our operations, sales and product teams and shown them that working with you makes things smoother, not slower. Now they bring you in early by default. You’ve guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. You’ve put clear governance and outcome monitoring in place for our live products, so Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation.

Alongside that, in the smaller DPO part of your role, you’ve taken ownership of our data protection agenda. You’ve gone looking for ways to improve, made the changes happen, and given our senior leaders an honest picture of where we stand.

To do this you'll be involved in:

Compliance advisory (around 70% of your time)

  • Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments, from first idea through product approval to launch, with data protection built in from the start.

  • Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.

  • Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.

  • Marketing: working on marketing materials, both ours and our customers’, to make sure they comply with regulation and our own policies, and that our financial promotions are properly challenged.

  • Service (Operations): building regulatory and data protection requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use.

  • Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time.

  • Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, including personal data breaches, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes.

  • Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge.

Data Protection Officer (around 30% of your time - training will be provided if needed)

Being our DPO means:

  • advising our teams on their obligations, including data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and transfer risk assessments (TRAs)

  • monitoring how well we comply with the UK GDPR, other global data protection laws and our own policies

  • training colleagues and raising awareness of data protection

  • being our contact point for the ICO and for people with questions or requests about their data

As our DPO, you’ll report directly to our COO and have the independence you need to do the job well. We’ll involve you early in anything that affects personal data.

We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

We need a proactive compliance doer first and foremost. You get stuck in without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable tackling regulations you haven’t met before. You use your experience and expertise to help our teams find simple, clear and compliant solutions. Your advice is balanced, easy to follow and focused on the risks that matter most. You want to push the business forward, and you see good compliance as part of how we get there.

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • Compliance experience in the first (preferred) or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm.

  • Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products, like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations. As well as familiarity with HMRC requirements like BBSI and AEOI reporting.

  • Hands-on experience turning regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams.

  • An openness to picking up data protection as part of the role: a genuine interest is enough, DPO experience isn’t required.

  • A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against.

  • The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn’t right.

  • A love of writing. We have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write).

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar.

  • Have been a DPO, or worked closely with one, in a regulated firm.

  • Have worked in finance or banking.

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

description:

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Most sales roles hand you a territory, a playbook and a quota. This one hands you a market that does not exist yet. We are looking for a builder: someone who would rather create a market than inherit one. Our first enterprise customers are live and the signal is clear. Everything after that is yours to build.

Putting physical AI onto a production line is not a software sale. It reaches the plant manager, the COO, the unions, health and safety, IT, procurement, and often the CEO. Deals take time, run through site visits and technical assessments, and are won on trust. Your job is to close our first deals in the UK and turn them into a market we own.

 

We look for ownership, high agency and low ego, someone who wants to shape both our customer base, shape how we sell and succeed.

  • Close our first enterprise deals in the UK. Own each one end to end, from first conversation to signed contract.

  • Develop the playbook as you go: who we sell to, how we price, what wins and what does not. The next ten sellers will run on what you build.

  • Take what you learn on the floor back to product, research and deployment.

Requirements

  • A track record of building, wherever you earned it: a market, a team, a company, a product line. Something that exists because you made it.

  • Enterprise sales experience. You have closed long, complex deals with many stakeholders, and you know how to keep them moving when they stall.

  • At your best in ambiguity. No map, no precedent, no one to ask.

  • You sell a vision and people trust you with it. Honest, likeable, low ego, high standards.

  • Willing to get your hands dirty. You build the account lists, write the proposals, and go to site yourself.

  • Based in London, in the office, with regular travel to customer sites.

Nice to Have

  • You have sold to operations buyers: plant or site managers, COOs, heads of manufacturing or logistics.

  • You have run pilots, POCs, or hardware-plus-software deals.

  • You have been early somewhere: founding AE, first sales hire, or early Head of Sales.

  • A background in operations consulting, VC, or as a founder.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Caen.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

title: Account Executive - Financial Services
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Le compte professionnel représente un enjeu central dans la stratégie de Pennylane :

  • Pour ses clients : Assurer le meilleur service possible en intégrant le compte professionnel directement dans leur outil de gestion/compta, assurant la possibilité de gérer l’entièreté de leur activité depuis 1 seul et même outil : Pennylane

  • Pour Pennylane : Faire grossir la part des Financial Services dans le revenu global de Pennylane.

C’est pourquoi nous créons une équipe dédiée sur ce périmètre.

🛣️ Mission et objectifs

👀 Vision

  • Transformer tous les utilisateurs en utilisateurs du compte pro Pennylane,

  • Faire des financial services un des principaux leviers de croissance de Pennylane.

Objectifs 2026

  • Part des Financial Services dans le revenu de Pennylane : x2,3

  • Nombre d’utilisateur de notre compte pro intégré ⇒ x1,9

2027

  • Part des Financial Services dans le revenu de Pennylane ⇒ x2 vs 2026

  • Nombre d’utilisateur de notre compte pro intégré ⇒ x2,3

2030 → Faire des financial services un des principaux leviers de croissance de Pennylane.

🫡 Mission

L’équipe AE Financial Services - SME a pour mission de transformer les TPEs (0-9 employés) clientes de Pennylane, en titulaires et utilisatrices d’un Compte Professionnel intégré à leur outil, leur permettant de gérer depuis Pennylane leurs achats (paiements fournisseurs, notes de frais, cartes bancaires, dépenses online) et vente (réception des paiements clients).

🎯 Objectif

L’équipe est objectivée sur le nombre de compte professionnels ouverts.

🖼️ Périmètre et responsabilités

Sales

Responsable de l’entièreté du cycle de vente

  • Identification des clients prioritaires ;

  • Contacting ;

  • Qualification ;

  • Closing.

Reporting

  • Documenter les actions dans Salesforce ;

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Financial Services, Marketing, Ops, Produit ;

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration du playbook (scripts, méthodologies …) et du funnel ;

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process.

  • Reporting.

⇒ En tant que création d’équipe, la capacité à identifier, remonter, optimiser, sera clé dans la réussite de la mission.

🫵 Profil recherché

  • Expérience en vente SDR, customer success/AM (avec forte appétence acquisition) ;

  • Goût pour les objectifs de conversion ;

  • Capacité à gérer un volume important de leads ;

  • Aisance au téléphone ;

  • Capacité à expliquer simplement un produit financier ;

  • Très bonne organisation ;

  • Rigueur CRM ;

  • capacité à travailler avec des équipes internes et des prestataires ;

  • capacité à identifier un blocage et à escalader au bon interlocuteur ;

title: Conversion Manager - Financial Services
description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Conversion Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • Contentsquare

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer - Paris/Grenoble
description:
Principal Thermal Solutions Engineer – Paris/Grenoble

About Vinci

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy and determinism of traditional simulation and the speed and scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world's most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market, and integrated into complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European technical sales team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci's platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating the transformative value of our software.

By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition, showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges, including both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci's capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci's technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline, and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, and partner directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci's differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions, either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial track record: Direct experience commercializing technical software, ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools, into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-to-market experience: Prior experience within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging tech adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Don't just use AI; help redefine how next-generation hardware is designed.

  • Work at the convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

 
 

À propos de Vinci

Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés et mis en production.

 

Présentation du poste

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l’adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d’ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d’accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d’améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la physique thermique et des stratégies de refroidissement, vous guiderez l’analyse de systèmes complexes de gestion thermique, notamment les phénomènes de transfert de chaleur, d’écoulement des fluides et de dissipation thermique, en régime permanent comme transitoire. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que les risques thermiques, la fiabilité des composants, la densité de puissance et l’efficacité des solutions de refroidissement, afin de concevoir des systèmes de gestion thermique performants pour les équipements de nouvelle génération.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d’usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d’interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l’équipe américaine

 

Responsabilités

  • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, en définissant l’orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l’équipe, et en pilotant l’exécution sur le terrain à travers l’Europe.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

  • Piloter l’accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l’onboarding, le déploiement et l’expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

  • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

  • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d’événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

  • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+ ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en gestion thermique et solutions de refroidissement — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client.

Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations.

Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie.

Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes.

Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA.

description:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

  • Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

  • Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

  • Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

     
 

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

  • Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

  • Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

  • Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

  • Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

 

Example Projects

  • Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

  • Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

  • Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

 

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

 

About Linkup

 

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

title: Field Marketing Manager - Paris
description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Marketing Team

Marketing at Pelico is a growth function, not a support function. We work hand-in-hand with Sales and BDRs to create qualified pipeline with the largest industrial companies in the world. Our audience is senior: COOs, VPs of Operations, supply chain, and manufacturing leaders at enterprise accounts.

Events are one of our strongest levers for reaching them: trade shows, executive dinners, roundtables, webinars, and Pelico-hosted events in Europe and the US—occasionally co-hosted with partners and industry bodies, which means co-building the format, splitting the cost, and sharing the audience. We measure ourselves on meetings and pipeline, not on badge scans.

Your Mission

You'll own Pelico's event growth engine end-to-end, turning field events into a measurable, efficient source of qualified pipeline and customer engagement.

  • Decide what we do and what we stop: You own the portfolio—which events we commit to, which we drop, and which formats get more budget next year. This is the heart of the role.

  • Own the event portfolio from strategy and prioritization through delivery, follow-up, and post-event review: That covers trade shows, webinars, executive dinners, roundtables, as well as Pelico-hosted, customer, and partner events.

  • Tie every event to a commercial outcome: For each event, you'll define the target accounts and audiences, the meeting and pipeline goals, and the metrics that matter.

  • Run delivery and budget with discipline: You'll set clear timelines, owners, and vendor plans, keeping spend under control across many activities at once.

  • Get Sales and BDRs committed: No event goes ahead without Sales ownership, a prospecting plan, pre-booked meetings, and a named follow-up owner.

  • Make results visible: You'll set up reliable lead capture and HubSpot tracking so leads, meetings, opportunities, and costs can be tracked for every event.

  • Turn events into content: Speaker and customer interviews, event films, social coverage, and approvals with appearing customers—coordinated with team members who produce it.

  • Expect travel: Up to 3 trips per quarter, including on-site setup days.

Your Impact

  • Field events become a measurable contributor to pipeline, meetings, and MQLs.

  • Budget moves toward the formats that work—scaling efficient levers like webinars and challenging underperforming formats before investing in them again.

  • A repeatable event playbook (targeting, execution, lead capture, follow-up, and post-event review) is published and used across Marketing, Sales, and BDRs.

  • Pelico is seen as the premier enterprise B2B player in its category: executives want to attend Pelico events and return for the next one.

What We're Looking For

This is a hands-on ownership role. You set the strategy, run the execution yourself, and answer for the results.

You'll need:

  • Proven experience owning a multi-format B2B SaaS/tech event portfolio end-to-end: strategy, delivery, follow-up, and review.

  • A commercial mindset. You choose events for named audiences and business goals, not for prestige or attendance, and you can explain your go/no-go trade-offs.

  • Strong budget and ROI discipline, with hands-on use of metrics like cost per MQL and cost per meeting.

  • Experience aligning Sales and BDR teams on event goals, ownership, and follow-up.

  • Experience co-building events with partners: agreeing on the format, splitting costs, and keeping both brands served.

  • Solid CRM habits. HubSpot is a strong plus: lead capture, tracking, and reporting from first contact to opportunity.

  • Excellent organization across many events running in parallel with partners, vendors, and internal teams.

  • AI-native ways of working: practical AI workflows for targeting, research, or reporting, with clear human judgment on top.

  • Fluent English. For the Paris role, professional French is also required.

Nice to have:

  • Background in aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, or supply chain.

  • Experience with executive- and enterprise-level events (C-level dinners, roundtables).

  • Managerial experience.

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctorant en vision et apprentissage : Détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments
description:
Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire

Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions.

Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos.

Présentation de la thématique :

Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments.

Description de la mission

La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable.

Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée.

Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments.

Le planning envisagé est le suivant :

Phase 1 – Acquisition et préparation des données (M1–M12)

•      Définition des protocoles de mesure avec CMDL (typologies de bâtiments, scénarios de défauts).

•      Réalisation de campagnes de mesures robotisées (IR + RGB) sur plusieurs sites pilotes.

•      Constitution d’un jeu de données annoté (défauts, zones saines, contexte BIM).

Phase 2 – Contextualisation spatiale et fusion multimodale (M3–M5)

•      Alignement spatial des images IR et RGB, prise en compte de la géométrie des façades.

•      Développement de méthodes de fusion multimodale pour produire des représentations conjointes robustes.

Phase 3 – Segmentation sémantique et filtrage des perturbations (M6–M9)

•      Développement de modèles de segmentation sémantique pour distinguer les zones pertinentes (parois, menuiseries, éléments techniques) des perturbations (mobilier, objets, reflets).

•      Intégration de connaissances expertes CMDL pour guider les classes et les règles de filtrage.

Phase 4 – Détection d’anomalies et classification des défauts (M10–M16)

•      Mise en place de modèles de détection d’anomalies thermiques et de classification des défauts (ponts thermiques, défauts d’étanchéité à l’air, artefacts liés aux matériaux).

•      Apprentissage frugal à partir de jeux de données limités, complétés éventuellement par des données simulées.

Phase 5 – Génération du diagnostic et validation en environnement pertinent (M16–M18)

•      Génération automatique de diagnostics structurés (liste de défauts, typologie, sévérité) et localisation dans le plan/BIM.

•      Campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux bâtiments, comparaison avec l’analyse d’experts humains (temps, précision, taux de faux positifs/faux négatifs).

•      Consolidation de la preuve de concept (TRL 5) et préparation des suites de valorisation.


Profil recherché / Compétences attendues

Diplômes : Doctorat en Informatique

Connaissances requises : Vision par Ordinateurs, Apprentissage automatique, Apprentissage profond

Compétences opérationnelles : Bonne maîtrise du langage Python et de librairies d’apprentissage profond telles que PyTorch, de l’anglais, et bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et de communication orale

Compétences comportementales : Motivation, rigueur, autonomie, proactivité.

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en deux étapes, supervisé par une commission de recrutement, en conformité avec la politique OTMR de Centrale Lyon.

·         Étude du dossier écrit : CV + lettre de motivation + diplôme de doctorat

·         Entretien de sélection : en présentiel ou en visioconférence

 

Date limite de candidature : 8 novembre 2026

It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.
